system.description: You place a silver coin on the tongue of a skull.

outcomes.triumph: You may ask four questions instead of three.
outcomes.success: The skull answers three questions about what it saw in life. It is grumpy and cynical, and treats its own death as a clerical error.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the skull stays silent, and keeps the coin.
outcomes.ruin: The skull answers, but lies with every word. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
